response.sql: SELECT AVG(per_order.avg_remaincount) AS avg_of_order_averages, SUM(per_order.exec_count) AS total_execution_count FROM (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remaincount, COUNT(*) AS exec_count FROM orderexecutions WHERE expirespot > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY ordersmark) AS per_order;
